    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_APPLY.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_UNIT_KEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_LANGUAGE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_EXPECTED_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SET_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_MSEHL) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_REQUEST) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SYSTEM) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CLIENT) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_USER) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_COMMITTED) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_BEFORE_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TEXT_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TASK) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TABKEY) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGID) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_MSGNO) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ES_TEXT) TYPE  T006A",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "\" 此 RFC 自己拥有 LUW；仅限现有 T006A 描述，不创建单位或语言行。",
    "DATA: lv_unit TYPE t006a-msehi,",
    "      lv_language TYPE t006a-spras,",
    "      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,",
    "      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "      lv_request TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_task TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_policy TYPE t000-cccoractiv,",
    "      ls_parent TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_header TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_checked_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      ls_checked_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071,",
    "      lt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071k,",
    "      lv_not_lockable TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      lv_locktype TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      ls_before TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_after TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_readback TYPE t006a,",
    "      lt_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,",
    "      lv_read_code TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_system TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_client TYPE string,",
    "      lv_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_after_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_unit_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_request_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_task_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_commit_started TYPE c,",
    "      lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "      lv_matches TYPE i,",
    "      lv_hash_data TYPE string,",
    "      lv_algorithm TYPE hashalg VALUE 'SHA2'.",
    "CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_user, ev_committed,",
    "       ev_before_version,",
    "       ev_text_version, ev_task, ev_tabkey, ev_msgid, ev_msgno, es_text.",
    "ev_system = sy-sysid.",
    "ev_client = sy-mandt.",
    "ev_user = sy-uname.",
    "IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF strlen( iv_unit_key ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_unit_key ) > 3",
    "OR strlen( iv_language ) <> 1 OR strlen( iv_expected_version ) <> 64",
    "OR iv_expected_version CN '0123456789abcdef'",
    "OR strlen( iv_request ) <> 10 OR strlen( iv_task ) <> 10",
    "OR iv_request = iv_task.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^[A-Za-z0-9]$' IN iv_language.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_request.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^GR2K[0-9]{6}$' IN iv_task.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit = iv_unit_key.",
    "lv_language = iv_language.",
    "lv_request = iv_request.",
    "lv_task = iv_task.",
    "IF iv_unit_key(1) = space OR strlen( lv_unit ) <> strlen( iv_unit_key )",
    "OR iv_unit_key CA '*|'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_unit_key.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht <> space AND iv_set_mseht <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl <> space AND iv_set_msehl <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_set_msehl = space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_mseht <> space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = space AND iv_msehl <> space ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "\" 空值清除仍需独立业务验收，本版仅允许非空描述。",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_mseht ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_mseht ) > 10",
    "       OR iv_mseht CO space OR iv_mseht CP ' *' ) )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_msehl ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_msehl ) > 30",
    "       OR iv_msehl CO space OR iv_msehl CP ' *' ) ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_mseht.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_msehl.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "DO 2 TIMES.",
    "  IF sy-index = 1.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006A'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR lv_group.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat",
    "    WHERE tabname = lv_table.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_group = '&NC&'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_TABU_DIS'",
    "    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '02' ID 'DICBERCLS' FIELD lv_group.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDDO.",
    "\" E_TABLE 的初始 VARKEY 在已读生成函数中变为 *，覆盖 CUNI 的维度锁。",
    "\" 不等待；该全表锁会短暂阻止其他客户端/单位的 CUNI 维护。",
    "CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TABLE'",
    "  EXPORTING tabname = 'T006' varkey = space _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "  EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'UNIT_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "  ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit_locked = 'X'.",
    "TRY.",
    "  DO 1 TIMES.",
    "    \" 仅锁指定父请求和任务；TRINT_LOCK_REQUEST 自带 COMMIT，不能复用。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_request _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_request_locked = 'X'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_task _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_task_locked = 'X'.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE cccoractiv INTO lv_policy FROM t000 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mandt = sy-mandt.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_policy NA '01'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CLIENT_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" ALE_EDIT_CHECK_2 含无条件 MESSAGE I；有 CUNI 分布式规则就拒绝。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd72 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE objekttyp = 'T' AND objektname = 'CUNI'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 标准模型读取会缓存/过滤规则；本版拒绝所有 CONDAT 记录，保守限缩范围。",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM tbd05 BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE mestyp = 'CONDAT'.",
    "    IF lv_matches > 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'ALE_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_parent-trkorr = lv_request.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_parent",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_parent-trfunction <> 'W'",
    "    OR ls_parent-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_parent-strkorr <> space",
    "    OR ls_parent-client <> sy-mandt OR ls_parent-tarsystem = space.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_header-trkorr = lv_task.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
    "      CHANGING cs_request = ls_header",
    "      EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_header-trfunction <> 'Q'",
    "    OR ls_header-trstatus <> 'D' OR ls_header-strkorr <> lv_request",
    "    OR ls_header-as4user <> sy-uname OR ls_header-client <> sy-mandt.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_CONTAINER_INVALID'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 锁内调用同一个只读 API，版本包含键、别名和两个描述的完整行。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_READ'",
    "      EXPORTING iv_unit_key = iv_unit_key iv_language = iv_language",
    "      IMPORTING ev_code = lv_read_code ev_system = lv_read_system",
    "        ev_client = lv_read_client ev_text_version = lv_version",
    "        es_text = ls_before",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_read_code <> 'READ'",
    "    OR lv_read_system <> 'GR2' OR lv_read_client <> '200'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'READ_PRECONDITION_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF lv_version <> iv_expected_version.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 表缓冲读不作为锁内新鲜度证据，必须与数据库完整行一致。",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_VERSION_CHANGED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_after = ls_before.",
    "    IF iv_set_mseht = 'X'. ls_after-mseht = iv_mseht. ENDIF.",
    "    IF iv_set_msehl = 'X'. ls_after-msehl = iv_msehl. ENDIF.",
    "    IF ls_after = ls_before.",
    "      ev_code = 'NO_CHANGES'.",
    "      ev_before_version = lv_version.",
    "      ev_text_version = lv_version.",
    "      es_text = ls_before.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_object-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_object-object = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_object-obj_name = 'CUNI'.",
    "    ls_object-objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_OBJECT'",
    "      EXPORTING is_object = ls_object is_request_header = ls_header",
    "        iv_check_lockability = 'X' iv_dialog = space",
    "        iv_release_checks = space",
    "      IMPORTING es_object = ls_checked_object",
    "        ev_object_not_lockable = lv_not_lockable",
    "        ev_locktype = lv_locktype",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_OBJECT_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 拒绝需要版本管理/TLOCK/修复分支的对象，保持本版单一 DB LUW。",
    "    IF lv_not_lockable <> 'X' OR lv_locktype <> space",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-pgmid <> 'R3TR'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-object <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-obj_name <> 'CUNI'",
    "    OR ls_checked_object-objfunc <> 'K'.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCKABLE_OBJECT_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ls_key-pgmid = 'R3TR'.",
    "    ls_key-object = 'TABU'.",
    "    ls_key-objname = 'T006A'.",
    "    ls_key-mastertype = 'TDAT'.",
    "    ls_key-mastername = 'CUNI'.",
    "    CONCATENATE ls_before-mandt ls_before-spras ls_before-msehi",
    "      INTO ls_key-tabkey RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_REQ_CHECK_KEY'",
    "      EXPORTING is_key = ls_key is_request_header = ls_header",
    "      IMPORTING es_key = ls_checked_key",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_checked_key-tabkey <> ls_key-tabkey",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-pgmid <> 'R3TR' OR ls_checked_key-object <> 'TABU'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-objname <> 'T006A'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastertype <> 'TDAT'",
    "    OR ls_checked_key-mastername <> 'CUNI'.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_KEY_CHECK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    APPEND ls_object TO lt_objects.",
    "    APPEND ls_key TO lt_keys.",
    "    \" 继续运行标准所有权/对象/语言键校验，所有跳过检查标志均保持默认。",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_APPEND_TO_COMM_ARRAYS'",
    "      EXPORTING wi_trkorr = lv_task iv_dialog = space",
    "      TABLES wt_e071 = lt_objects wt_e071k = lt_keys",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_APPEND_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND obj_name = 'CUNI' AND objfunc = 'K'.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT COUNT( * ) INTO lv_matches FROM e071k",
    "      WHERE trkorr = lv_task AND pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = 'TABU'",
    "        AND objname = 'T006A' AND mastertype = 'TDAT'",
    "        AND mastername = 'CUNI'",
    "        AND tabkey = ls_key-tabkey.",
    "    IF lv_matches < 1.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_RECORDING_NOT_OBSERVED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 同步调用标准 UPDATE_T006A，避免 CTS 先提交而 V1 更新后失败。",
    "    APPEND ls_after TO lt_text.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'UPDATE_T006A'",
    "      TABLES t006a_tab = lt_text",
    "      EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_UPDATE_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    CLEAR ls_readback.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_readback",
    "      FROM t006a BYPASSING BUFFER",
    "      WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_readback <> ls_after.",
    "      ev_code = 'TEXT_READBACK_FAILED'.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    \" 仍在 SAP 中按只读 API 的固定宽度 v1 格式计算真实数据库行版本。",
    "    CONCATENATE 'T006A:v1:' sy-sysid ls_readback-mandt ls_readback-spras",
    "      ls_readback-msehi ls_readback-mseh3 ls_readback-mseh6",
    "      ls_readback-mseht ls_readback-msehl",
    "      INTO lv_hash_data RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR'",
    "      EXPORTING alg = lv_algorithm data = lv_hash_data",
    "      IMPORTING hashstring = lv_after_version",
    "      EXCEPTIONS unknown_alg = 1 param_error = 2 internal_error = 3",
    "        error_message = 4 OTHERS = 5.",
    "    lv_rc = sy-subrc.",

    "  DEFINE validate_enh_transport.",
    "    IF iv_package IS INITIAL OR iv_package = '$TMP'",
    "       OR iv_request IS INITIAL.",
    "      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'ENH_WRITE_INPUT_REQUIRED'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Transportable package and request required'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.6'. RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    CLEAR: ls_package, ls_request, ls_task.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tdevc INTO ls_package",
    "      WHERE devclass = iv_package.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Transportable package does not exist'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.6'. RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_request",
    "      WHERE trkorr = iv_request.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Transport request or task does not exist'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.6'. RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF ls_request-strkorr IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "      ls_task = ls_request.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_request",
    "        WHERE trkorr = ls_task-strkorr.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_task",
    "        WHERE strkorr = ls_request-trkorr",
    "          AND as4user = sy-uname AND trstatus = 'D'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF ls_request-trfunction <> 'K'",
    "       OR ls_request-trstatus <> 'D'",
    "       OR ls_task-trstatus <> 'D'",
    "       OR ls_task-as4user <> sy-uname.",
    "      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_NOT_MODIFIABLE'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Open workbench task for user is required'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.6'. RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    lv_enh_devclass = iv_package.",
    "    lv_enh_trkorr = ls_task-trkorr.",
    "  END-OF-DEFINITION.",
    "  DEFINE emit_fm_difference.",
    "* One native difference per section; values bounded to 60 chars.",
    "    IF &2[] <> &3[].",
    "      ADD 1 TO lv_fm_diff_id.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'SECTION' &1.",
    "      lv_fm_diff_count = lines( &2 ).",
    "      add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'EXPECTED_ROWS'",
    "        lv_fm_diff_count.",
    "      lv_fm_diff_count = lines( &3 ).",
    "      add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'ACTUAL_ROWS'",
    "        lv_fm_diff_count.",
    "      LOOP AT &2 ASSIGNING <ls_fm_diff_expected>.",
    "        lv_fm_diff_row = sy-tabix.",
    "        READ TABLE &3 ASSIGNING <ls_fm_diff_actual>",
    "          INDEX lv_fm_diff_row.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'ROW'",
    "            lv_fm_diff_row.",
    "          add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'FIELD'",
    "            'MISSING_ROW'.",
    "          EXIT.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF <ls_fm_diff_expected> = <ls_fm_diff_actual>.",
    "          CONTINUE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'ROW'",
    "          lv_fm_diff_row.",
    "        lo_fm_diff ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data(",
    "          <ls_fm_diff_expected> ).",
    "        lt_fm_diff_components = lo_fm_diff->get_components( ).",
    "        LOOP AT lt_fm_diff_components INTO ls_fm_diff_component.",
    "          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fm_diff_component-name",
    "            OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_diff_expected>",
    "            TO <lv_fm_diff_expected>.",
    "          IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.",
    "          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fm_diff_component-name",
    "            OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_diff_actual>",
    "            TO <lv_fm_diff_actual>.",
    "          IF sy-subrc <> 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.",
    "          IF <lv_fm_diff_expected> = <lv_fm_diff_actual>.",
    "            CONTINUE.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'FIELD'",
    "            ls_fm_diff_component-name.",
    "          lv_fm_diff_text = <lv_fm_diff_expected>.",
    "          add_repo_payload 'D' lv_fm_diff_id 'EXPECTED'",
    "            lv_fm_diff_text.",

    "  DEFINE fm_guard_section.",
    "* Arguments: direction text, payload kind, key field, payload",
    "* rows and live rows. Rows are matched by parameter name and",
    "* only the properties the payload names are compared, so a",
    "* read-back-only field cannot fail the guard. A parameter",
    "* without a live row is the addition being requested.",
    "    IF lv_fm_guard_error IS INITIAL.",
    "      LOOP AT &4 ASSIGNING <ls_fm_guard_expected>.",
    "        lv_fm_guard_index = sy-tabix.",
    "        CLEAR: lv_fm_guard_key, lv_fm_guard_found,",
    "          lv_fm_guard_mismatch.",
    "        ASSIGN COMPONENT &3 OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_guard_expected>",
    "          TO <lv_fm_guard_name>.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          CONTINUE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF <lv_fm_guard_name> IS INITIAL.",
    "          CONTINUE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        lv_fm_guard_key = <lv_fm_guard_name>.",
    "        LOOP AT &5 ASSIGNING <ls_fm_guard_current>.",
    "          ASSIGN COMPONENT &3 OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_guard_current>",
    "            TO <lv_fm_guard_live_name>.",
    "          IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            CONTINUE.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF <lv_fm_guard_live_name> <> lv_fm_guard_key.",
    "            CONTINUE.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          lv_fm_guard_found = 'X'.",
    "          LOOP AT lt_fm_field INTO ls_fm_field",
    "            WHERE kind = &2 AND position = lv_fm_guard_index.",
    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fm_field-property",
    "              OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_guard_expected>",
    "              TO <lv_fm_guard_expected_value>.",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "              CONTINUE.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_fm_field-property",
    "              OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_guard_current>",
    "              TO <lv_fm_guard_live_value>.",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "              CONTINUE.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            IF <lv_fm_guard_expected_value>",
    "               = <lv_fm_guard_live_value>.",
    "              CONTINUE.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            lv_fm_guard_mismatch = 'X'.",
    "            lv_fm_guard_property = ls_fm_field-property.",
    "            lv_fm_guard_expected_text =",
    "              <lv_fm_guard_expected_value>.",
    "            lv_fm_guard_actual_text =",
    "              <lv_fm_guard_live_value>.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          EXIT.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        IF lv_fm_guard_found IS INITIAL.",
    "          CONTINUE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_fm_guard_mismatch IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "          lv_fm_guard_error = 'X'.",
    "          lv_fm_guard_direction = &1.",
    "          CLEAR lv_fm_diff_id.",
    "          emit_fm_difference &1 &4 &5.",
    "          EXIT.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  END-OF-DEFINITION.",
    "  DEFINE fm_guard_no_removal.",
    "* Arguments: direction text, key field, payload rows, live rows.",
    "* A live parameter the payload never names would be removed or",
    "* renamed, which this opcode must never do silently.",
    "    IF lv_fm_guard_removal IS INITIAL.",
    "      LOOP AT &4 ASSIGNING <ls_fm_guard_current>.",
    "        CLEAR: lv_fm_guard_key, lv_fm_guard_found.",
    "        ASSIGN COMPONENT &2 OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_guard_current>",
    "          TO <lv_fm_guard_live_name>.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          CONTINUE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF <lv_fm_guard_live_name> IS INITIAL.",
    "          CONTINUE.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        lv_fm_guard_key = <lv_fm_guard_live_name>.",
    "        LOOP AT &3 ASSIGNING <ls_fm_guard_expected>.",
    "          ASSIGN COMPONENT &2 OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_guard_expected>",
    "            TO <lv_fm_guard_name>.",
    "          IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            CONTINUE.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF <lv_fm_guard_name> = lv_fm_guard_key.",
    "            lv_fm_guard_found = 'X'.",
    "            EXIT.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        IF lv_fm_guard_found IS INITIAL.",
    "          lv_fm_guard_removal = 'X'.",
    "          lv_fm_guard_direction = &1.",
    "          EXIT.",
    "        ENDIF.",

    "    ENDIF.",

    "          documentation = lt_fm_documentation",

    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",

    "      ev_status = 'S'.",
    "      ev_code = 'FUNCTION_INTERFACE_READ'.",

    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tdevc INTO ls_package",

    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_NOT_FOUND'.",

    "      IF ls_request-strkorr IS NOT INITIAL.",

    "        SELECT SINGLE * FROM e070 INTO ls_task",

    "      IF ls_request-trfunction <> 'K'",

    "        ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_NOT_MODIFIABLE'.",

    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tfdir INTO ls_tfdir",
    "        WHERE funcname = iv_object_name.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'FUNCTION_EXISTS'.",

    "      ENDIF.",
    "      REFRESH: lt_fm_import, lt_fm_export,",

    "        ENDIF.",

    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",

    "            WHILE lines( lt_fm_export ) < lv_payload_index.",
    "              CLEAR ls_fm_export.",
    "              APPEND ls_fm_export TO lt_fm_export.",
    "            ENDWHILE.",
    "            READ TABLE lt_fm_export ASSIGNING <ls_fm_export>",
    "              INDEX lv_payload_index.",
    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_payload_property",
    "              OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_export>",
    "              TO <lv_payload_component>.",
    "          WHEN 'C'.",
    "            WHILE lines( lt_fm_changing ) < lv_payload_index.",

    "              APPEND ls_fm_changing TO lt_fm_changing.",

    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_payload_property",

    "              TO <lv_payload_component>.",
    "          WHEN 'T'.",
    "            WHILE lines( lt_fm_tables ) < lv_payload_index.",
    "              CLEAR ls_fm_table.",
    "              APPEND ls_fm_table TO lt_fm_tables.",
    "            ENDWHILE.",
    "            READ TABLE lt_fm_tables ASSIGNING <ls_fm_table>",

    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_payload_property",
    "              OF STRUCTURE <ls_fm_table>",

    "          ev_code = 'FUNCTION_PROPERTY_INVALID'.",

    "          ev_version = '1.3'.",

    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_function_pool = iv_program.",
    "      lv_short_text = iv_description.",

    "        lt_fm_changing, lt_fm_tables,",
    "        lt_fm_exceptions, lt_fm_documentation,",
    "        lt_fm_source.",
    "      CLEAR: lv_global_flag, lv_remote_call,",

    "          function_pool = lv_function_pool",
    "        TABLES import_parameter = lt_fm_current_import",

    "      lt_fm_exceptions[] = lt_fm_current_exceptions[].",

    "      lt_fm_source[] = lt_fm_current_source[].",
    "* The same parse runs twice over the two snapshots the caller sent.",

    "        REFRESH: lt_fm_import, lt_fm_export,",

    "          lt_fm_documentation, lt_fm_field.",

    "          lv_payload_value.",

    "          ev_version = '2.0'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        lv_payload_index = lv_payload_index_text.",
    "        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%7C'",
    "          IN lv_payload_value WITH '|'.",
    "        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%25'",
    "          IN lv_payload_value WITH '%'.",
    "        IF lv_payload_property = 'PASSVALUE'",
    "           AND lv_fm_payload_kind <> 'T'.",
    "          lv_payload_property = 'REFERENCE'.",
    "          IF lv_payload_value = 'X'.",
    "            CLEAR lv_payload_value.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            lv_payload_value = 'X'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_payload_index <= 0",

    "          ev_version = '2.0'. RETURN.",

    "        IF lv_payload_property = 'TEXT'",

    "          CLEAR ls_fm_documentation.",
    "          CASE lv_fm_payload_kind.",

    "                ls_fm_export-parameter.",

    "            ENDIF.",
    "            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_payload_property",

    "          WHEN 'S'.",
    "            IF lv_payload_property <> 'LINE'.",
    "              CALL FUNCTION 'DEQUEUE_ESFUNCTION'",

    "              ev_code = 'FUNCTION_PROPERTY_INVALID'.",

    "            ENDIF.",
    "* Source rows describe the pre-ADT snapshot. Preserve the",
    "* active post-ADT source and verify it after doc update.",

    "          WHEN 'M'.",
    "* Metadata rows (FUNCTION_GROUP, SHORT_TEXT, REMOTE_ENABLED,",

    "* describe the caller snapshot header, not the interface.",

    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'FUNCTION_PATCH_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",

    "          ev_code = 'FUNCTION_PROPERTY_INVALID'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Unknown function payload property'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.0'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        <lv_payload_component> = lv_payload_value.",
    "* Record the property this row names so the pre-write guard",

    "        ls_fm_field-kind = lv_fm_payload_kind(1).",

    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF lt_fm_source[] <> lt_fm_current_source[].",

    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'FUNCTION_SOURCE_CHANGE_REJECTED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Interface patch cannot change source'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.0'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "* Pre-write guard: the payload may add parameters, but every",
    "* parameter it keeps must still carry the values the payload",

    "        fm_guard_no_removal 'CHANGING' 'PARAMETER'",
    "          lt_fm_changing lt_fm_current_changing.",
    "        fm_guard_no_removal 'TABLES' 'PARAMETER'",
    "          lt_fm_tables lt_fm_current_tables.",

    "        CLEAR lv_fm_diff_id.",

    "* End of the second pass: the working tables now hold the desired",

    "      ENDDO.",
    "* Preserve native cross-direction indices and row order.",
    "      lt_fm_requested_documentation[] = lt_fm_documentation[].",

    "      LOOP AT lt_fm_documentation ASSIGNING <ls_fm_documentation>.",

    "* The rows the current interface did not consume describe the",

    "    WHEN 'CREATE_TRANSPORT_REQUEST'.",

    "          ev_status = 'E'.",

    "          ev_message = 'Serialized object payload is invalid'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%7C'",
    "          IN lv_payload_value WITH '|'.",
    "        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%25'",
    "          IN lv_payload_value WITH '%'.",
    "        WHILE lines( lt_d9_add_objects ) < lv_payload_index.",
    "          CLEAR ls_d9_add_object.",
    "          APPEND ls_d9_add_object TO lt_d9_add_objects.",
    "        ENDWHILE.",
    "        READ TABLE lt_d9_add_objects",
    "          ASSIGNING <ls_d9_add_object>",
    "          INDEX lv_payload_index.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Object payload row is missing'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_payload_property = 'OBJECT_TABLES'.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_KEYS_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Table keys are not accepted here'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_payload_property <> 'PGMID'",
    "           AND lv_payload_property <> 'OBJECT'",
    "           AND lv_payload_property <> 'OBJ_NAME'",
    "           AND lv_payload_property <> 'LANG'.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Object property is not accepted'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_payload_property",
    "          OF STRUCTURE <ls_d9_add_object>",
    "          TO <lv_payload_component>.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Object property does not exist'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        <lv_payload_component> = lv_payload_value.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF lt_d9_add_objects IS INITIAL.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECTS_REQUIRED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'At least one object is required'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      LOOP AT lt_d9_add_objects INTO ls_d9_add_object.",
    "        IF ls_d9_add_object-pgmid IS INITIAL",
    "           OR ls_d9_add_object-object IS INITIAL",
    "           OR ls_d9_add_object-obj_name IS INITIAL.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_INCOMPLETE'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Every object needs PGMID, OBJECT, name'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      CLEAR: lv_d9_add_order, lv_d9_add_task,",
    "        lv_d9_add_subrc.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          iv_order = lv_d9_add_order_in",
    "          iv_with_dialog = 'D'",
    "          iv_send_message = 'X'",
    "          it_obj_entries = lt_d9_add_objects",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          ev_order = lv_d9_add_order",
    "          ev_task = lv_d9_add_task",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          OTHERS = 1.",
    "      lv_d9_add_subrc = sy-subrc.",
    "      IF lv_d9_add_subrc <> 0.",
    "        CLEAR lv_d9_add_error_text.",
    "        IF sy-msgid IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "          MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty",
    "            NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "            INTO lv_d9_add_error_text.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF lv_d9_add_error_text IS INITIAL.",
    "          lv_d9_add_error_text =",
    "            'Objects were not added'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_INSERT_FAILED'.",
    "        ev_message = lv_d9_add_error_text.",
    "        ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.",
    "      REFRESH lt_d9_add_e071.",
    "      IF lv_d9_add_task IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "        SELECT trkorr pgmid object obj_name FROM e071",
    "          INTO TABLE lt_d9_add_e071",
    "          WHERE trkorr = lv_d9_add_task.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF lv_d9_add_order IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "        SELECT trkorr pgmid object obj_name FROM e071",
    "          APPENDING TABLE lt_d9_add_e071",
    "          WHERE trkorr = lv_d9_add_order.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_d9_add_expected = lines( lt_d9_add_objects ).",
    "      CLEAR lv_d9_add_inserted.",
    "      LOOP AT lt_d9_add_objects INTO ls_d9_add_object.",
    "        CLEAR ls_d9_add_e071.",
    "        READ TABLE lt_d9_add_e071 INTO ls_d9_add_e071",
    "          WITH KEY pgmid = ls_d9_add_object-pgmid",
    "                   object = ls_d9_add_object-object",
    "            obj_name = ls_d9_add_object-obj_name.",
    "        IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "          ADD 1 TO lv_d9_add_inserted.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF lv_d9_add_inserted < lv_d9_add_expected.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECT_NOT_PERSISTED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Not every object reached E071'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.8'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      REFRESH it_source.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'REQUEST' lv_d9_add_order.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'TASK' lv_d9_add_task.",
    "      lv_d9_add_count_text = lv_d9_add_expected.",
    "      CONDENSE lv_d9_add_count_text NO-GAPS.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'OBJECT_COUNT'",
    "        lv_d9_add_count_text.",
    "      lv_d9_add_count_text = lv_d9_add_inserted.",
    "      CONDENSE lv_d9_add_count_text NO-GAPS.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'INSERTED_COUNT'",
    "        lv_d9_add_count_text.",
    "      CLEAR lv_d9_add_index.",
    "      LOOP AT lt_d9_add_objects INTO ls_d9_add_object.",
    "        ADD 1 TO lv_d9_add_index.",
    "        add_repo_payload 'T' lv_d9_add_index 'PGMID'",
    "          ls_d9_add_object-pgmid.",
    "        add_repo_payload 'T' lv_d9_add_index 'OBJECT'",
    "          ls_d9_add_object-object.",
    "        add_repo_payload 'T' lv_d9_add_index 'OBJ_NAME'",
    "          ls_d9_add_object-obj_name.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      ev_status = 'S'.",
    "      ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_OBJECTS_ADDED'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Objects added to the transport'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.8'.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    WHEN 'JOB_RELEASE'.",
    "      IF iv_jobname IS INITIAL OR iv_jobcount IS INITIAL.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_IDENTITY_REQUIRED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job name and count are required'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.13'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_job_name = iv_jobname.",
    "      TRANSLATE lv_job_name TO UPPER CASE.",
    "      lv_job_count = iv_jobcount.",
    "      CLEAR ls_job_db.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tbtco INTO ls_job_db",
    "        WHERE jobname = lv_job_name AND jobcount = lv_job_count.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job does not exist'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.13'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_job_status_before = ls_job_db-status.",
    "      IF lv_job_status_before <> 'P' AND lv_job_status_before <> 'S'.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_NOT_RELEASABLE'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Only a scheduled or released job can be released'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.13'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'BP_JOB_RELEASE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          jobname = lv_job_name",
    "          jobcount = lv_job_count",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          ret = lv_job_ret",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          missing_jobname = 1",
    "          missing_jobcount = 2",
    "          missing_start_date = 3",
    "          status_not_scheduled = 4",
    "          cant_enq_job = 5",
    "          cant_start_job_immediately = 6",
    "          no_privilege_to_release_job = 7",
    "          cant_release_job = 8",
    "          job_not_exist = 9",
    "          job_have_no_steps = 10",
    "          error_job_modify = 11",
    "          OTHERS = 12.",
    "      lv_job_subrc = sy-subrc.",
    "      IF lv_job_subrc <> 0.",
    "        IF lv_job_subrc = 7.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_NO_AUTHORITY'.",
    "          ev_message = 'No privilege to release the job'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_job_subrc = 9.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Job does not exist'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_job_subrc = 10.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_HAVE_NO_STEPS'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Job has no steps'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_RELEASE_FAILED'.",
    "          WRITE lv_job_subrc TO lv_job_subrc_text.",
    "          CONCATENATE 'Job could not be released (SAP subrc'",
    "            lv_job_subrc_text ')' INTO ev_message.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ev_version = '2.13'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.",
    "      CLEAR ls_job_db.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tbtco INTO ls_job_db",
    "        WHERE jobname = lv_job_name AND jobcount = lv_job_count.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_NOT_FOUND_AFTER_RELEASE'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job disappeared after release'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.13'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_job_status_after = ls_job_db-status.",
    "      IF lv_job_status_after = lv_job_status_before.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_STATUS_UNCHANGED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Release did not change the job status'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.13'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      REFRESH it_source.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'JOBNAME' lv_job_name.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'JOBCOUNT' lv_job_count.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'STATUS_BEFORE'",
    "        lv_job_status_before.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'STATUS' lv_job_status_after.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'RELEASED' 'X'.",
    "      ev_status = 'S'.",
    "      ev_code = 'JOB_RELEASED'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Job released and status read back'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.13'.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    WHEN 'JOB_CANCEL'.",
    "      IF iv_jobname IS INITIAL OR iv_jobcount IS INITIAL.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_IDENTITY_REQUIRED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job name and count are required'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.14'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_job_name = iv_jobname.",
    "      TRANSLATE lv_job_name TO UPPER CASE.",
    "      lv_job_count = iv_jobcount.",
    "      CLEAR ls_job_db.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tbtco INTO ls_job_db",
    "        WHERE jobname = lv_job_name AND jobcount = lv_job_count.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job does not exist'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.14'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_job_status_before = ls_job_db-status.",
    "      IF lv_job_status_before = 'R'.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING'.",
    "        ev_message = 'A running job cannot be cancelled'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.14'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      CLEAR: lv_job_commit, lv_job_forced.",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'BP_JOB_DELETE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          jobcount = lv_job_count",
    "          jobname = lv_job_name",
    "          forcedmode = lv_job_forced",
    "          commitmode = lv_job_commit",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          cant_delete_event_entry = 1",
    "          cant_delete_job = 2",
    "          cant_delete_joblog = 3",
    "          cant_delete_steps = 4",
    "          cant_delete_time_entry = 5",
    "          cant_derelease_successor = 6",
    "          cant_enq_predecessor = 7",
    "          cant_enq_successor = 8",
    "          cant_enq_tbtco_entry = 9",
    "          cant_update_predecessor = 10",
    "          cant_update_successor = 11",
    "          commit_failed = 12",
    "          jobcount_missing = 13",
    "          jobname_missing = 14",
    "          job_does_not_exist = 15",
    "          job_is_already_running = 16",
    "          no_delete_authority = 17",
    "          OTHERS = 18.",
    "      lv_job_subrc = sy-subrc.",
    "      IF lv_job_subrc <> 0.",
    "        IF lv_job_subrc = 15.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Job does not exist'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_job_subrc = 16.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_ALREADY_RUNNING'.",
    "          ev_message = 'A running job cannot be cancelled'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_job_subrc = 17.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_NO_AUTHORITY'.",
    "          ev_message = 'No delete authority for this job'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_job_subrc = 9.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_LOCKED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'The job entry is locked'.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_job_subrc = 12.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_COMMIT_FAILED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'The delete could not be committed'.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_CANCEL_FAILED'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Job could not be cancelled'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ev_version = '2.14'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.",
    "      CLEAR ls_job_db.",
    "      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tbtco INTO ls_job_db",
    "        WHERE jobname = lv_job_name AND jobcount = lv_job_count.",
    "      IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_STILL_PRESENT'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job is still present after cancel'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.14'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      REFRESH it_source.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'JOBNAME' lv_job_name.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'JOBCOUNT' lv_job_count.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'STATUS_BEFORE'",
    "        lv_job_status_before.",
    "      add_repo_payload 'M' '1' 'CANCELLED' 'X'.",
    "      ev_status = 'S'.",
    "      ev_code = 'JOB_CANCELLED'.",
    "      ev_message = 'Job cancelled and absence read back'.",
    "      ev_version = '2.14'.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    WHEN 'JOB_CREATE'.",
    "      IF iv_jobname IS INITIAL.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_IDENTITY_REQUIRED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Job name is required'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF iv_jobcount IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_COUNT_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message = 'A new job must not carry a job count'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      lv_job_name = iv_jobname.",
    "      TRANSLATE lv_job_name TO UPPER CASE.",
    "      CLEAR: lv_job_target_user, lv_job_start_date,",
    "        lv_job_start_time, lv_job_start_date_given,",
    "        lv_job_start_time_given.",
    "      CLEAR: lv_job_step_count, lv_job_step_index.",
    "      REFRESH lt_job_step_in.",
    "      LOOP AT it_source INTO ls_source.",
    "        CLEAR: lv_payload_kind, lv_payload_index_text,",
    "          lv_payload_property, lv_payload_value.",
    "        SPLIT ls_source-line AT '|' INTO lv_payload_kind",
    "          lv_payload_index_text lv_payload_property",
    "          lv_payload_value.",
    "        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%7C'",
    "          IN lv_payload_value WITH '|'.",
    "        REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%25'",
    "          IN lv_payload_value WITH '%'.",
    "        TRANSLATE lv_payload_property TO UPPER CASE.",
    "        IF lv_payload_kind = 'H'.",
    "          IF lv_payload_index_text <> '1'.",
    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "            ev_message = 'Header index must be one'.",
    "            ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF lv_payload_property = 'TARGET_USER'.",
    "            lv_job_target_user = lv_payload_value.",
    "          ELSEIF lv_payload_property = 'START_DATE'.",
    "            lv_job_start_date = lv_payload_value.",
    "            lv_job_start_date_given = 'X'.",
    "          ELSEIF lv_payload_property = 'START_TIME'.",
    "            lv_job_start_time = lv_payload_value.",
    "            lv_job_start_time_given = 'X'.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "            ev_message = 'Header property not allowed'.",
    "            ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ELSEIF lv_payload_kind = 'S'.",
    "          IF lv_payload_index_text IS INITIAL",
    "             OR lv_payload_index_text CN '0123456789'.",
    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "            ev_message = 'Step index is invalid'.",
    "            ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          lv_job_step_index = lv_payload_index_text.",
    "          IF lv_job_step_index < 1 OR lv_job_step_index > 20.",
    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'JOB_TOO_MANY_STEPS'.",
    "            ev_message = 'At most 20 steps are allowed'.",
    "            ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          CLEAR ls_job_step_in.",
    "          READ TABLE lt_job_step_in INTO ls_job_step_in",
    "            WITH KEY step_index = lv_job_step_index.",
    "          IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            lv_job_step_count = lv_job_step_count + 1.",
    "            IF lv_job_step_index <> lv_job_step_count.",
    "              ev_status = 'E'.",
    "              ev_code = 'JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "              ev_message = 'Step indexes must be consecutive'.",
    "              ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            CLEAR ls_job_step_in.",
    "            ls_job_step_in-step_index = lv_job_step_index.",
    "            APPEND ls_job_step_in TO lt_job_step_in.",
    "            DESCRIBE TABLE lt_job_step_in",
    "              LINES lv_job_step_tabix.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            lv_job_step_tabix = sy-tabix.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          IF lv_payload_property = 'PROGRAM'.",
    "            ls_job_step_in-program = lv_payload_value.",
    "          ELSEIF lv_payload_property = 'VARIANT'.",
    "            ls_job_step_in-variant = lv_payload_value.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            ev_status = 'E'.",
    "            ev_code = 'JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "            ev_message = 'Step property not allowed'.",
    "            ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          MODIFY lt_job_step_in FROM ls_job_step_in",
    "            INDEX lv_job_step_tabix.",
    "        ELSE.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_PAYLOAD_INVALID'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Payload row kind is not allowed'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF lv_job_start_date_given IS INITIAL",
    "         OR lv_job_start_time_given IS INITIAL.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_START_TIME_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Start date and time are required'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF lv_job_start_date CN '0123456789'",
    "         OR lv_job_start_time CN '0123456789'.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_START_TIME_INVALID'.",
    "        ev_message = 'Start date or time is not numeric'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_job_step_in LINES lv_job_step_count.",
    "      IF lv_job_step_count < 1.",
    "        ev_status = 'E'.",
    "        ev_code = 'JOB_STEP_REQUIRED'.",
    "        ev_message = 'At least one step is required'.",
    "        ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      LOOP AT lt_job_step_in INTO ls_job_step_in.",
    "        IF ls_job_step_in-program IS INITIAL.",
    "          ev_status = 'E'.",
    "          ev_code = 'JOB_STEP_INVALID'.",
    "          ev_message = 'Every step needs a program'.",
    "          ev_version = '2.19'. RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF lv_job_target_user IS INITIAL.",

    "    WHEN 'READ_TEXT_ELEMENTS' OR 'MERGE_TEXT_ELEMENTS'.",

    "        REFRESH lt_text_changes.",
    "        LOOP AT it_source INTO ls_source.",

    "        LOOP AT lt_text_changes ASSIGNING <ls_text_change>.",
    "* The kind selects which text pool row ID this entry is written to:",

    "          ENDIF.",
    "* The pool key is eight characters wide and blank padded, so every ID",

    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "* A selection text ID is a selection screen element name: one to eight",

    "      lv_function_pool = ls_tfdir-pname+4.",

    "      CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_ESFUNCTION'",

    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_READ.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",

    "*\"  IMPORTING",

    "*\"     VALUE(IV_LANGUAGE) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",

    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TEXT_VERSION) TYPE  STRING",
    "*\"     VALUE(ES_TEXT) TYPE  T006A",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "\" ECC 7.31 的 HASHALG 为 CHAR4；SHA2 返回 SHA-256。",
    "CONSTANTS lc_algorithm TYPE hashalg VALUE 'SHA2'.",
    "DATA: lv_unit TYPE t006a-msehi,",
    "      lv_language TYPE t006a-spras,",
    "      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,",
    "      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,",
    "      lv_length TYPE i,",

    "      lv_hash TYPE string.",

    "CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_text_version, es_text.",
    "ev_system = sy-sysid.",
    "ev_client = sy-mandt.",
    "IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",

    "  RETURN.",

    "FIND REGEX '^[A-Za-z0-9]$' IN iv_language.",
    "IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "lv_unit = iv_unit_key.",
    "lv_language = iv_language.",
    "IF iv_unit_key(1) = space OR strlen( lv_unit ) <> strlen( iv_unit_key )",
    "OR iv_unit_key CS '|'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_unit_key.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "\" 未分配授权组时沿用 CUNI 的 &NC& 规则，逐表校验读取权限。",

    "  IF sy-index = 1.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006A'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR lv_group.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat",
    "    WHERE tabname = lv_table.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_group = '&NC&'.",

    "    ev_code = 'AUTHORIZATION_DENIED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDDO.",
    "SELECT SINGLE spras INTO lv_language FROM t002",

    "  ev_code = 'LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "SELECT SINGLE mandt spras msehi mseh3 mseh6 mseht msehl",
    "  INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF es_text FROM t006a",
    "  WHERE spras = lv_language AND msehi = lv_unit.",

    "  INTO lv_data RESPECTING BLANKS.",
    "CALL FUNCTION 'CALCULATE_HASH_FOR_CHAR'",

    "FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_UNIT_APPLY.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",

    "*\"     VALUE(ES_TEXT) TYPE  T006A",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "\" 此 RFC 自己拥有 LUW；仅限现有 T006A 描述，不创建单位或语言行。",
    "DATA: lv_unit TYPE t006a-msehi,",
    "      lv_language TYPE t006a-spras,",
    "      lv_table TYPE tddat-tabname,",
    "      lv_group TYPE tddat-cclass,",

    "      lv_task TYPE e070-trkorr,",
    "      lv_policy TYPE t000-cccoractiv,",

    "      ls_header TYPE trwbo_request_header,",
    "      ls_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_checked_object TYPE e071,",
    "      ls_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      ls_checked_key TYPE e071k,",
    "      lt_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071,",
    "      lt_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF e071k,",
    "      lv_not_lockable TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      lv_locktype TYPE trpari-s_locktype,",
    "      ls_before TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_after TYPE t006a,",
    "      ls_readback TYPE t006a,",
    "      lt_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t006a,",
    "      lv_read_code TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_system TYPE string,",
    "      lv_read_client TYPE string,",
    "      lv_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_after_version TYPE string,",
    "      lv_unit_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_request_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_task_locked TYPE c,",
    "      lv_commit_started TYPE c,",
    "      lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc,",
    "      lv_matches TYPE i,",
    "      lv_hash_data TYPE string,",
    "      lv_algorithm TYPE hashalg VALUE 'SHA2'.",
    "CLEAR: ev_code, ev_system, ev_client, ev_user, ev_committed,",
    "       ev_before_version,",
    "       ev_text_version, ev_task, ev_tabkey, ev_msgid, ev_msgno, es_text.",
    "ev_system = sy-sysid.",
    "ev_client = sy-mandt.",
    "ev_user = sy-uname.",
    "IF sy-sysid <> 'GR2' OR sy-mandt <> '200'.",
    "  ev_code = 'SCOPE_UNSUPPORTED'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF strlen( iv_unit_key ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_unit_key ) > 3",
    "OR strlen( iv_language ) <> 1 OR strlen( iv_expected_version ) <> 64",
    "OR iv_expected_version CN '0123456789abcdef'",
    "OR strlen( iv_request ) <> 10 OR strlen( iv_task ) <> 10",
    "OR iv_request = iv_task.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "FIND REGEX '^[A-Za-z0-9]$' IN iv_language.",

    "lv_language = iv_language.",
    "lv_request = iv_request.",
    "lv_task = iv_task.",

    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",

    "FIND REGEX '[[:cntrl:]]' IN iv_unit_key.",
    "IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "IF ( iv_set_mseht <> space AND iv_set_mseht <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl <> space AND iv_set_msehl <> 'X' )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_set_msehl = space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_mseht = space AND iv_mseht <> space )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = space AND iv_msehl <> space ).",
    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",

    "IF ( iv_set_mseht = 'X' AND",
    "     ( strlen( iv_mseht ) < 1 OR strlen( iv_mseht ) > 10",
    "       OR iv_mseht CO space OR iv_mseht CP ' *' ) )",
    "OR ( iv_set_msehl = 'X' AND",

    "  ev_code = 'INPUT_INVALID'.",
    "  RETURN.",
    "ENDIF.",
    "DO 2 TIMES.",
    "  IF sy-index = 1.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    lv_table = 'T006A'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR lv_group.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE cclass INTO lv_group FROM tddat",
    "    WHERE tabname = lv_table.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_group IS INITIAL.",
    "    lv_group = '&NC&'.",

    "      EXPORTING trkorr = lv_task _scope = '1' _wait = space",
    "      EXCEPTIONS foreign_lock = 1 system_failure = 2 OTHERS = 3.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      ev_code = 'CTS_LOCK_FAILED'.",
    "      ev_msgid = sy-msgid. ev_msgno = sy-msgno.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDIF.",

    "      EXPORTING iv_read_e070 = 'X' iv_read_e070c = 'X'",
